examples.chinese: 媽媽說可樂太甜了，不讓我喝第二瓶。
examples.pinyin: Māma shuō kělè tài tián le, bú ràng wǒ hē dì'èr píng.
examples.english: Mom said cola is too sweet and won't let me drink a second bottle.

examples.chinese: A:我好渴，想喝可樂或是冰奶茶。 B:那些飲料都太甜了，不如喝水，這樣比較健康。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ hǎo kě, xiǎng hē kělè huòshì bīng nǎichá. B: Nàxiē yǐnliào dōu tài tián le, bùrú hē shuǐ, zhèyàng bǐjiào jiànkāng.
examples.english: A: I'm so thirsty. I want to drink cola or iced milk tea. B: Those drinks are all too sweet. We'd better drink water; that's healthier.

examples.chinese: 教授說，期末考的筆試比較難，一定要好好地複習。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu shuō, qímòkǎo de bǐshì bǐjiào nán, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de fùxí.
examples.english: The professor said the written exam for the final will be relatively difficult, so you must review well.

examples.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
examples.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
examples.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

examples.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
examples.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
examples.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

examples.chinese: 林同學上課很專心，也很認真地把老師教的寫下來，這樣回家就能複習了。
examples.pinyin: Lín tóngxué shàngkè hěn zhuānxīn, yě hěn rènzhēn de bǎ lǎoshī jiāo de xiě xiàlái, zhèyàng huí jiā jiù néng fùxí le.
examples.english: Student Lin is very focused in class and also very seriously writes down what the teacher teaches, so that he can review when he goes home.

examples.chinese: 我同學記筆記的速度很快，也記得很清楚，所以我常跟他借筆記來複習功課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué jì bǐjì de sùdù hěn kuài, yě jì de hěn qīngchu, suǒyǐ wǒ cháng gēn tā jiè bǐjì lái fùxí gōngkè.
examples.english: My classmate takes notes very quickly and also remembers them very clearly, so I often borrow his notes to review my lessons.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 剛學的詞和語法最好常使用、多複習，如此才能加深記憶。
examples.pinyin: Gāng xué de cí hé yǔfǎ zuì hǎo cháng shǐyòng, duō fùxí, rúcǐ cái néng jiāshēn jìyì.
examples.english: It's best to frequently use and review more the words and grammar you've just learned—only in this way can you deepen your memory.

examples.chinese: 不斷複習生字卡片能幫我們記住新的字。
examples.pinyin: Bùduàn fùxí shēngzì kǎpiàn néng bāng wǒmen jìzhù xīn de zì.
examples.english: Constantly reviewing vocabulary flashcards can help us remember new characters.

examples.chinese: 他的工作很忙，不但常常加班，還要做市場研究。
examples.pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò hěn máng, búdàn chángcháng jiābān, háiyào zuò shìchǎng yánjiù.
examples.english: His job is very busy; not only does he often work overtime, he also has to do market research.

examples.chinese: 王教授推薦我去念那個研究所的翻譯課程。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuījiàn wǒ qù niàn nàge yánjiùsuǒ de fānyì kèchéng.
examples.english: Professor Wang recommended that I go study the translation course at that graduate institute.

examples.chinese: 他為了研究環境和文化的關係，用了不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile yánjiù huánjìng hé wénhuà de guānxì, yòng le bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: In order to research the relationship between environment and culture, he spent quite a lot of time.

examples.chinese: 妹妹知道自己考上了最好的研究所，激動地哭了起來。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei zhīdào zìjǐ kǎo shàng le zuìhǎo de yánjiùsuǒ, jīdòng de kū le qǐlái.
examples.english: When my younger sister learned that she had gotten into the best graduate school, she was so excited that she started crying.

examples.chinese: 那個明星演戲前都會先研究戲裡的人物、故事，最後才決定表演的方式。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng yǎnxì qián dōu huì xiān yánjiū xì lǐ de rénwù, gùshì, zuìhòu cái juédìng biǎoyǎn de fāngshì.
examples.english: Before that star acts in a drama, he always first studies the characters and story in the play, and only then decides on the way to perform.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 那個明星對穿著很講究，總是花很多時間，研究什麼上衣配什麼長褲才好看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge míngxīng duì chuānzhuó hěn jiǎngjiū, zǒngshì huā hěn duō shíjiān, yánjiū shénme shàngyī pèi shénme chángkù cái hǎokàn.
examples.english: That star is very particular about apparel, always spending a lot of time researching what top goes with what pants to look good.

examples.chinese: 顏先生對吃、喝都很講究，吃牛排時應該喝什麼酒，他也很有研究。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiānsheng duì chī, hē dōu hěn jiǎngjiū, chī niúpái shí yīnggāi hē shénme jiǔ, tā yě hěn yǒu yánjiū.
examples.english: Mr. Yan is very particular about eating and drinking; he has also studied what wine should be drunk when eating steak.

examples.chinese: 王教授不但知識很豐富，研究成果也受到大家的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu búdàn zhīshi hěn fēngfù, yánjiū chéngguǒ yě shòudào dàjiā de kěndìng.
examples.english: Professor Wang not only has abundant knowledge, but his research results are also recognized by everyone.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese:
理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。
著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin:
Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng.
Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english:
In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation.
The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 前主任一天到晚做研究，連周末也不休息，這樣身體怎麼受得了？
examples.pinyin: Qián zhǔrèn yītiāndàowǎn zuò yánjiū, lián zhōumò yě bù xiūxi, zhèyàng shēntǐ zěnme shòudeliǎo?
examples.english: The former director did research all day long, not even resting on weekends; how could his body endure that?

examples.chinese: 那位博士在本次會議中所提到的問題，值得我們進一步研究。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi bóshì zài běn cì huìyì zhōng suǒ tí dào de wèntí, zhídé wǒmen jìnyībù yánjiū.
examples.english: The problems that that PhD mentioned in this conference are worth our further study.

examples.chinese: 當聽到周博士多年的研究終於有了成果時，所有員工都給他最大的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tīngdào Zhōu bóshì duōnián de yánjiū zhōngyú yǒu le chéngguǒ shí, suǒyǒu yuángōng dōu gěi tā zuì dà de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: When they heard that Dr. Zhou's years of research had finally produced results, all the employees gave him the biggest applause.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 這一盤棋你下得真好，你一定花了很多工夫研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yì pán qí nǐ xià de zhēn hǎo, nǐ yídìng huā le hěn duō gōngfu yánjiū.
examples.english: You played this game of chess really well; you must have spent a lot of effort studying.

examples.chinese: 他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén nénglì yǐ dádào xiāngdāng hǎo de shuǐzhǔn, zài Táiwān niàn yánjiūsuǒ méi wèntí.
examples.english: His Chinese ability has already reached a fairly good level; studying at a graduate school in Taiwan is no problem.

examples.chinese: 根據美國某項研究資料，青少年因腦震盪而被送到醫院的意外中，超過一半是因為激烈運動引起的。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù Měiguó mǒu xiàng yánjiū zīliào, qīngshàonián yīn nǎozhèndàng ér bèi sòng dào yīyuàn de yìwài zhōng, chāoguò yībàn shì yīnwèi jīliè yùndòng yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: According to a certain American research study, among accidents in which teenagers are sent to the hospital due to cerebral concussion, more than half are caused by intense sports.

examples.chinese: 這項研究計畫只針對少部分區域實驗，參考價值不高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū jìhuà zhǐ zhēnduì shǎo bùfèn qūyù shíyàn, cānkǎo jiàzhí bù gāo.
examples.english: This research project only conducts experiments in a small number of areas, so its reference value is not high.

examples.chinese: 這本書是這位作家的代表作品，研究他的人都很熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū shì zhè wèi zuòjiā de dàibiǎo zuòpǐn, yánjiū tā de rén dōu hěn shúxī.
examples.english: This book is this author's representative work; those who study him are all very familiar with it.

examples.chinese: 李博士在國際上相當有名，他的研究總能引發學者討論。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóshì zài guójì shàng xiāngdāng yǒumíng, tā de yánjiū zǒng néng yǐnfā xuézhě tǎolùn.
examples.english: Dr. Li is quite famous internationally; his research always sparks discussions among scholars.

examples.chinese: 我跟幾個愛好歷史的朋友一起組了社團，專門研究古文物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jǐ ge àihào lìshǐ de péngyǒu yìqǐ zǔ le shètuán, zhuānmén yánjiū gǔ wénwù.
examples.english: I formed a club together with several friends who love history, specifically to study ancient artifacts.

examples.chinese: 你忙不過來的時候就該找人幫忙，別讓自己累壞了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ máng bú guòlái de shíhou jiù gāi zhǎo rén bāngmáng, bié ràng zìjǐ lèihuài le.
examples.english: When you are too busy to manage, you should find someone to help; don't let yourself get exhausted.

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese: A:小張病了三天了，不但全身沒力，還發高燒。 B:最近很多人都這樣，應該是感冒了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiǎo Zhāng bìng le sān tiān le, bùdàn quánshēn méi lì, hái fā gāoshāo. B: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén dōu zhèyàng, yīnggāi shì gǎnmào le.
examples.english: A: Xiao Zhang has been ill for three days; not only does his whole body have no strength, but he also has a high fever. B: Many people have been like this recently; it's probably a cold.

examples.chinese:
王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。
每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin:
Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn.
Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english:
Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family.
After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 父母除了教導孩子做人做事的道理，也應該肯定他們的表現，讓他們更有自信。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ chúle jiàodǎo háizi zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ, yě yīnggāi kěndìng tāmen de biǎoxiàn, ràng tāmen gèng yǒu zìxìn.
examples.english: Besides teaching children the principles of how to conduct themselves and do things, parents should also affirm their performance so that they have more confidence.

examples.chinese: 我認為多看時尚雜誌、多看模特兒怎麼穿衣服，應該就能使自己的穿著更有品味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi duō kàn shíshàng zázhì, duō kàn mótè'er zěnme chuān yīfu, yīnggāi jiù néng shǐ zìjǐ de chuānzhuó gèng yǒu pǐnwèi.
examples.english: I think that by reading more fashion magazines and looking more at how models wear clothes, you should be able to make your own clothing more tasteful.

examples.chinese: 顏先生對吃、喝都很講究，吃牛排時應該喝什麼酒，他也很有研究。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiānsheng duì chī, hē dōu hěn jiǎngjiū, chī niúpái shí yīnggāi hē shénme jiǔ, tā yě hěn yǒu yánjiū.
examples.english: Mr. Yan is very particular about eating and drinking; he has also studied what wine should be drunk when eating steak.

examples.chinese: A:聽說明天的會跟新商品的推銷計畫有關，你要參加嗎？ B:我是公司的安全人員，這個會應該跟我無關。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō míngtiān de huì gēn xīn shāngpǐn de tuīxiāo jìhuà yǒuguān, nǐ yào cānjiā ma? B: Wǒ shì gōngsī de ānquán rényuán, zhège huì yīnggāi gēn wǒ wúguān.
examples.english: A: I heard that tomorrow's meeting is related to the new product promotion plan; are you going to attend? B: I am the company's security personnel; this meeting should be unrelated to me.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 既然你那麼喜歡張小姐，就應該主動一點，約她去看電影、吃個飯什麼的。
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ nàme xǐhuān Zhāng xiǎojiě, jiù yīnggāi zhǔdòng yīdiǎn, yuē tā qù kàn diànyǐng, chī ge fàn shénme de.
examples.english: Since you like Miss Zhang so much, you should take the initiative a bit more—ask her out to a movie, a meal, or something.

examples.chinese:
我最喜歡的休閒活動是爬山和露營。
為了身體和心理的健康，就算再忙，假日也應該休閒一下。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de xiūxián huódòng shì páshān hé lùyíng.
Wèile shēntǐ hé xīnlǐ de jiànkāng, jiùsuàn zài máng, jiàrì yě yīnggāi xiūxián yīxià.
examples.english:
My favorite leisure activities are mountain climbing and camping.
For the sake of physical and mental health, even if you're busy, you should still take some leisure time on holidays.

examples.chinese:
沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。
不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin:
Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi.
Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english:
No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well.
Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese:
地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。
當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin:
Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng.
Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english:
During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury.
When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi rènzhēn sīkǎo zìjǐ de wèilái, bié húlǐhútú de guò rìzi.
examples.english: Everyone should seriously think about their own future, and not live their days muddleheadedly.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese:
小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。
有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo.
Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english:
Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today.
Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 今年的表演比去年的更有意思，我覺得你應該來看。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de biǎoyǎn bǐ qùnián de gèng yǒu yìsi, wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi lái kàn.
examples.english: This year's performance is even more interesting than last year's; I think you should come see it.

examples.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
examples.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
examples.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，大人、小孩都應該多注意身體。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ.
examples.english: Recently many people have colds; both adults and children should pay more attention to their health.

examples.chinese: 我不知道那個地方怎麼去，所以應該先查查地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhīdào nàge dìfāng zěnme qù, suǒyǐ yīnggāi xiān chácha dìtú.
examples.english: I don't know how to get to that place, so I should first check the map.

examples.chinese: 現在很晚了，你應該去睡覺了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn wǎn le, nǐ yīnggāi qù shuìjiào le.
examples.english: It's very late now; you should go to sleep.

examples.chinese: 醫生說，我應該多喝水，不需要吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, bù xūyào chī yào.
examples.english: The doctor said I should drink more water and don't need to take medicine.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，大家應該注意身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, dàjiā yīnggāi zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: Recently many people have caught colds; everyone should pay attention to their body's health.

examples.chinese: 我最近太胖了，應該多運動，少吃一點飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn tài pàng le, yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī yīdiǎn fàn.
examples.english: I've gotten too fat recently; I should exercise more and eat a little less food.

examples.chinese: 老師明天要考三十個中國字，我應該開始練習了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī míngtiān yào kǎo sānshí ge Zhōngguó zì, wǒ yīnggāi kāishǐ liànxí le.
examples.english: The teacher will test thirty Chinese characters tomorrow, so I should start practicing.

examples.chinese: 我不懂他的意思，不知道應該說什麼，所以有點兒緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù dǒng tā de yìsi, bù zhīdào yīnggāi shuō shénme, suǒyǐ yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: I don't understand what he means and don't know what I should say, so I am a bit nervous.

examples.chinese: 我們應該常常說請、謝謝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi chángcháng shuō qǐng, xièxie.
examples.english: We should say ‘please’, ‘thank you’ often.

examples.chinese: 他發燒了？那他應該去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Tā fāshāo le? Nà tā yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He has a fever? He should see a doctor then.

examples.chinese: 對，我應該多注意身體健康。
examples.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yīnggāi duō zhùyì shēntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: You are right. I should pay more attention to it.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese:
時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。
在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin:
Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le.
Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english:
Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly.
In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese:
這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。
A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin:
Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí.
A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english:
This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel.
A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 客人看了那件洋裝一眼就走了，應該不喜歡吧。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén kàn le nà jiàn yángzhuāng yì yǎn jiù zǒu le, yīnggāi bù xǐhuān ba.
examples.english: The customer took one glance at that dress and then left; she probably doesn't like it.

examples.chinese: 人的一生只有短短幾十年，應該把握時間，讓生活過得充實、 快樂。
examples.pinyin: Rén de yìshēng zhǐyǒu duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yīnggāi bǎwò shíjiān, ràng shēnghuó guò de chōngshí, kuàilè.
examples.english: A person's whole life is only a short few decades; one should grasp time and make life fulfilling and happy.

examples.chinese: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.
examples.english: When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests.

examples.chinese:
我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。
費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái.
Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english:
Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it.
Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: A:犯錯的人都可以請求原諒嗎？ B:得看他犯的是什麼錯，要是小小的錯，就該原諒吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Fàncuò de rén dōu kěyǐ qǐngqiú yuánliàng ma? B: Děi kàn tā fàn de shì shénme cuò, yàoshi xiǎoxiǎo de cuò, jiù gāi yuánliàng ba.
examples.english: A: Can everyone who makes a mistake ask for forgiveness? B: It depends on what mistake he made; if it's a small mistake, then he should be forgiven.

examples.chinese: A:我對何小姐是真心的，為什麼她一直不肯接受呢？ B:你應該更關心她、更體貼她，讓她知道你是真心愛她的。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ duì Hé xiǎojiě shì zhēnxīn de, wèishénme tā yìzhí bù kěn jiēshòu ne? B: Nǐ yīnggāi gèng guānxīn tā, gèng tǐtiē tā, ràng tā zhīdào nǐ shì zhēnxīn ài tā de.
examples.english: A: I am sincere toward Miss He; why does she keep refusing to accept me? B: You should care about her more and be more considerate of her, so she knows you truly love her.

examples.chinese:
博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。
每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin:
Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de.
Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english:
The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money.
Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

examples.chinese: 絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。
examples.pinyin: Jué dà bùfèn de Huárén dōu hěn zhòngshì Chūnjié, suǒyǐ huíjiā tuányuán, hùxiāng bàinián, tāmen rènwéi dōu shì gāi zuò de.
examples.english: The vast majority of Chinese people value the Spring Festival highly, so they believe that going home for family reunions and exchanging New Year greetings are things that should be done.

examples.chinese: A:我到底該怎麼做才能讓老闆滿意？ B:你太驕傲、個性太急， 做事也不夠仔細。總之， 先把自己的缺點改掉吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ dàodǐ gāi zěnme zuò cái néng ràng lǎobǎn mǎnyì? B: Nǐ tài jiāo'ào, gèxìng tài jí, zuòshì yě bù gòu zǐxì. Zǒngzhī, xiān bǎ zìjǐ de quēdiǎn gǎi diào ba.
examples.english: A: What on earth should I do to satisfy the boss? B: You are too arrogant, your personality is too impatient, and you are not careful enough in doing things. In short, first change your shortcomings.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese:
每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。
導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin:
Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù.
Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english:
Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing.
The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 「總統」是國家最高領導人，他領導全國民眾往前走，讓國家越來越進步。
examples.pinyin: 「Zǒngtǒng」 shì guójiā zuìgāo lǐngdǎorén, tā lǐngdǎo quánguó mínzhòng wǎng qián zǒu, ràng guójiā yuè lái yuè jìnbù.
examples.english: The "president" is the highest leader of the country; he leads the people of the whole nation forward, making the country more and more progressive.

examples.chinese:
這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。
我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì.
Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english:
This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance.
My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

items.wordHook: Combining 領(withdraw money) and 導(direct): 領導 means lead.

examples.chinese: A:你說自己沒有想做的事，難道你沒有夢想嗎？ B:我只想簡單過生活，再說，沒有夢想難道不行嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō zìjǐ méiyǒu xiǎng zuò de shì, nándào nǐ méiyǒu mèngxiǎng ma? B: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng jiǎndān guò shēnghuó, zàishuō, méiyǒu mèngxiǎng nándào bùxíng ma?
examples.english: A: You say you have nothing you want to do—don't you have dreams? B: I just want to live a simple life; besides, is it not okay to have no dreams?

examples.chinese:
這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。
我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin:
Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì.
Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english:
This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance.
My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己獨特的習俗，像華人除夕貼春聯、年夜飯的魚不能吃光就很特別。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ dútè de xísú, xiàng Huárén chúxī tiē chūnlián, niányèfàn de yú bù néng chī guāng jiù hěn tèbié.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own unique customs. For example, it is very special that Chinese people put up spring couplets on New Year's Eve and that the fish for the New Year's Eve dinner cannot be completely eaten.

examples.chinese: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store.

examples.chinese: 那家超市的生意非常好，因為他們進了很多特別的零食，大人、小孩都想嘗嘗看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì de shēngyì fēicháng hǎo, yīnwèi tāmen jìn le hěn duō tèbié de língshí, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xiǎng chángchang kàn.
examples.english: That supermarket's business is very good because they have stocked many special snacks; both adults and children want to taste them.

examples.chinese: 這道菜能夠這麼好吃，是因為加了特別的醬料，還有自己做的醬油。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài nénggòu zhème hǎochī, shì yīnwèi jiāle tèbié de jiàngliào, hái yǒu zìjǐ zuò de jiàngyóu.
examples.english: This dish can be so delicious because it has special sauce added, plus homemade soy sauce.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳很特別，沒有菜單。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng hěn tèbié, méiyǒu càidān.
examples.english: This restaurant is very special; it doesn't have a menu.

examples.chinese: 我記得有羊、馬、兔子……，最特別的是龍。（打開課本）妳看看……
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìdé yǒu yáng, mǎ, tùzi..., zuì tèbié de shì lóng. (dǎkāi kèběn) Nǐ kànkan...
examples.english: I remember there are goats, horses, rabbits..., and the most special one is the dragon. (Open the textbook) You see...

items.wordHook: 特(special) + 別(other) → set apart from others, so it's special.

examples.chinese: 金小姐常利用假日，牽著家中那隻活潑的小黑狗到街上逛逛。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiǎojiě cháng lìyòng jiàrì, qiānzhe jiā zhōng nà zhī huópō de xiǎo hēigǒu dào jiē shàng guàngguang.
examples.english: Miss Jin often uses her holidays to hold the leash of that lively little black dog at home and take it for a stroll on the streets.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

items.wordHook: Combining 求(beg) and 救(aid): 求救 means ask for help.
Writing on official 竹(bamboo) documents where 僉(all) parties affix their approval is to 簽(sign).
A 糹(silk) thread pulls in every loose strand, even the 悤(hurried) ones, winding them into one tight bundle → 總(gather).
Autumn 艹(grass) leaves dropping to the ground: 落(fall).
車(vehicle) + 站(station) → where vehicles stop: 車站(bus or rail station).
Combining 高(tall) and 大(big): 高大 means tall and big.
